title: BountyStat
description: StatBounty is a plugin for SMPs which adds a new currency by completing different actions, powered by statistics.
body:
# **StatBounty**

**StatBounty is a plugin for SMPs, powered by statistics, in which you earn points by completing a variaty of actions used for buying items from a customizable shop

### **Features:**
- configurable statistic point value
- point loss on death(death by player-all points, death by entity-half points)
- customizable bounty shop and auction with GUI
- custom items and events

### **Bounty Hunt Event**

When a Bounty Hunt starts a countdown for 60s starts which is announced on your screen. When the timer hits 0 a random online player gets chosen and a timer for 20s starts. The chosen player gets glowing and has their coordonates leaked every minute. There are 3 outcomes of this event:
1. The player is killed-the killer recieves 150% of the chosen players points
2. The player survives-the chosen player recieves 200% of their points and gets resistance 255 for 5 minutes(to escape)
3. The player disconnects-the chosen player dies and loses all of his points 

### **Custom Weapons**-found in shop and only one purchase
Bounty Sword-700 points

Bounty Axe-800 points

Bounty Mace-1000 points

Their abilities are found in the lore of the respective item. Secondary ability costs points and the primary ability has a cooldown. Passive is a potion effect for pvp

### **Commands**
- /statbounty help - Show help
- /statbounty points [player] - View points
- /statbounty add <player> <amount> - Admin: add points
- /statbounty remove <player> <amount> - Admin: remove points
- /statbounty set <player> <amount> - Admin: set points
- /statbounty top [limit] - Leaderboard
- /statbounty shop - Open the shop
- /statbounty ah - Open the auction house
- /statbounty event <start|stop> - Admin: start/stop bounty hunt
- /statbounty schedule <time> - Admin: schedule bounty hunt (examples: 20m, 90s, 4h)
- /statbounty giveweapon <sword|axe|mace> [player] - Admin: give a bounty weapon
- /statbounty reload - Admin: reload config
- /info <player> - Admin: show statistic rule breakdown
- /editshop - Admin: open the shop editor
